name: String lights
description: Warm globe bulbs on a sagging wire between two wooden posts, glowing at dusk
notes: Glass is emissive 'Bulb' (strength 2) in node 'Bulbs': brighten it at dusk. Wire and sockets are node 'Strand'. The wire hangs from 'start' to 'end' (the hooks) and dips to 2.1 m; the bulbs' bottoms are ~1.98 m up.
